comment.body: Thanks for reporting the intermittent high GPU utilization and that no trigger is known. The issue does not identify the exact value or dock surface, so telemetry/aggregation cannot be distinguished from formatting. When it appears again, please note the percentage and surface, then add a comment containing `/bugreport` immediately afterward. If Settings or the tray cannot open, run `BugReportTool.exe` from the PowerToys installation directory.
